g1-implement.title: engine: resolve a command check's cwd to the spine's repo root
g1-implement.imperative: Fill templates/IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF.template.md and dispatch a subagent invoking constellation-implementer. TASK: in scripts/checklist_engine.py, thread the already-available base_dir into _run_check_command and pass the enclosing repo/worktree root as cwd= to the subprocess.run call at line 787. Resolve the root by walking UP from base_dir for a .git entry, accepting BOTH a directory (plain checkout) and a FILE (linked worktree). No .git found, or base_dir is None -> pass cwd=None, i.e. exactly today's inherited-cwd behavior. Add a targeted regression test to tests/test_checklist_engine.py covering: (a) the fail-open -- a decoy file present only in the launcher's cwd must NOT satisfy a check; (b) the false-red -- a file present in the project must satisfy a check launched from elsewhere; (c) the no-repo fallback still inherits cwd; (d) a linked worktree (.git as a FILE) resolves to the worktree, not the main checkout. Integrate the returned IMPLEMENTER_RESULT with: attach g1-implement --type implementer-result --field status=complete

preconditions.statement: execution context loaded and the resolution target (repo root, not spine dir) confirmed from the frame

postconditions.statement: IMPLEMENTER_RESULT returned with no unresolved blockers (return status complete)

constraints: PRESERVE the POSIX-shell routing and the visible returncode-127 / no-posix-shell failure path. Add cwd= ONLY to the branch that already calls subprocess.run; do not touch the synthetic CompletedProcess branch.
FORBIDDEN FILES: scripts/hooks/spine_rail.py and scripts/agent_work_root.py must not be edited. If the fix appears to need them, STOP and report -- do not edit.
Do NOT use agent_work_root.durable_root(): it redirects a linked worktree to the MAIN checkout, which is the opposite of what a check needs.
No new hard dependency on git being installed -- resolve the root by filesystem walk, not by shelling out to git.
Never hand-edit any spine.json or execute.json; drive the engine.
